data.name: Makana
data.gender_notes: Makana is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Polynesian culture, the name Makana means 'gift' or 'grace'. This name is often given to a child as a reminder of the blessings and gifts bestowed upon them by their ancestors and their God. The name Makana carries the meaning “Gift, Grace” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Makana usually hope their child will grow to embody gift, grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
